items.title: Cyberattack Disrupts France’s Postal Service and Banking During Christmas Rush
items.description: A cyberattack knocked France’s national postal service offline, blocking and delaying package deliveries and online payments. The post Cyberattack Disrupts France’s Postal Service and Banking During Christmas Rush appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Malicious NPM Package with 56K Downloads Steals WhatsApp Messages
items.description: A dangerous npm package named “lotusbail” has been stealing WhatsApp messages and user data from thousands of developers worldwide. The package, which has been downloaded over 56,000 times, disguises itself as a legitimate WhatsApp Web API library while secretly running malware in the background.
